release_notes: The Cohu 3960 is an outdoor analog PTZ camera/positioner for traffic-control (NEMA TS2) systems, with a 1/4-inch CCD, 23x optical zoom, day/night switchover, and 360-degree continuous pan in a dry-nitrogen-pressurized IP67/NEMA 4X housing. Analog composite output with RS-422 multiprotocol serial PTZ control; no IP/ONVIF/RTSP. The 3965 is the 115 VAC input variant, the 3964 the 24 VAC variant.
